id: # Starter rows for a Hugo site.

args: parser=exitcode -- d="$(mktemp -d)"; hugo --gc --minify --quiet --destination "$d" > /dev/null; s=$?; rm -rf "$d"; exit $s
why: the site builds on every pushed commit, so a broken template never deploys
a merge-conflict marker left in a file breaks it for every reader
the gate configuration is changed by a human only, so an agent cannot loosen the gate that judges it
